page.layout: One printed page, text column right of centre with a marginal note column on the left. Running head and page number at the top of the text column. Heading "Latior omnium explicatio in pandectis." and the heading "AXIOMATA." with four numbered theses below, all in the text column. Right of the text, a strip of the neighbouring page's edge, not transcribed. Catchword at the lower right of the text column.

main_text.p: tum, impendisse in opus publicum 70. retinuisse 30. dicimus eum reddere 30. & insuper tertiam partem, id est, 10. proinde restitu-re 40. [Sed haec poena hodie quoque arbitraria est ut ceterae Groenew. d. §. 9. nu. 8. & c. de pœn.]

Unde ho-rum o-mnium la-tior expli-catio pe-tenda?12.§ {1} Sed de publicis judiciis hæc expofuimus, ut ve[?] bis possibile sit summo digito, & quasi per indicem ea tigisse: alioqui diligentior eorum scientia vobis ex latio-bus Digestorum seu Pandectarum libris Deo propitio a-ventura est.

Quinto, in §. ult. b. n. ostendit se breviter percurrisse, & qu[?] in indice proposuisse judicia publica.[id est summatim, digitè fontes, unde hauriatur intenso.] proinde exactiorem notitiam Digestis peti jubet.
main_text.head: AXIOMATA.
main_text.p: 1. Magna diversitas est inter judicia publica, & privata. in pri
2. In crimine lœsæ majestatis, punitur affectus, licet non sequur effectus. §. 3. conjun. l. 5. in Princ. C. ad leg. Jul. majest.
3. In parricidio æque conscius ac perpetrans delictum punitur.
4. In institutionibus per indicem singula demonstrantur, in par[illegible, ~3 letters]tis plenius §. fin. h.

page.notes: Cut-off lines: the right edge of the text column is cropped by the neighbouring page, so line ends such as "ut ve", "qu", "in pri", "in par" and "ceter" are incomplete as printed; "ea tigisse" may carry a stray letter at the line end. The mark before "Unde" in the margin is read as "1" and is uncertain; the same mark stands after "§." in the text. The hyphen after "restitu-", "ho-" and similar words is printed; the hyphen in "in par-tis" is not visible. The bracketed line after "ceteræ" is in the text column, not a margin note.
